description: The Career Path DC Clean and Safe Team serves as a resource within the District of Columbia by creating employment opportunities for the residents and creating a clean and safe environment within the communities we serve. We provide these individuals with intensive life skills and job readiness training, focusing on obtaining and maintaining employment, acceptable workplace behaviors, and overcoming barriers. The participants also receive work experience training, learning the methods of beautification within living, working, and business environments.

Jonez Nutrition Consulting Services, LLC (DBA Food Jonezi) is a Washington, D.C.-based health and wellness practice offering personalized nutrition counseling, education workshops, and healthy cooking classes. Serving a diverse audience—including Medicaid/Medicare participants, corporations, nonprofits, and government agencies—Food Jonezi has impacted over 9,000+ D.C. residents, facilitated 1,500+ workshops, and participated in 300+ community health fairs. Recognizing the greater need within underserved communities, Food Jonezi Friendz, its nonprofit arm, was launched in 2021 to focus on tackling food insecurity through culturally focused cooking classes, interactive workshops, and nutrition counseling. The nonprofit also introduced the Chef in Training program, equipping adolescents (ages 15-17) with essential food, nutrition, and culinary skills to foster healthier futures.
